notes.title: Update Notes for July 3, 2024
notes.content:
1.Fixed an issue causing certain items' dialogues to freeze.
2.Fixed the layer display issue for certain items.
3.Optimized the shapes of some damage zones.
4.Optimized collision for the "Deep Well" on the map.
5.Added animation details to character idle states.
6.Fixed a display error with the perfect completion score.
